contracts.compatibility_period: until orchestration contracts consume explicit portfolio identity
contracts.current_behavior: binds delegated work to an active goal or current work item
contracts.fields: active goal identity and work-item status
contracts.authority: can direct task selection if treated as current
contracts.target_behavior: bind packets to explicit selected issue and portfolio input
contracts.positive_proof: selected work-item packets bind explicit portfolio input
contracts.negative_proof: active-goal status alone cannot authorize a subtask

contracts.compatibility_period: until lifecycle contracts consume explicit portfolio identity
contracts.current_behavior: binds claims and waves to current active-goal state
contracts.fields: active goal, branch, claim, and work-item status
contracts.authority: can direct claims or writers if treated as current
contracts.target_behavior: derive claims from explicit live inputs and selected work
contracts.positive_proof: lifecycle contracts consume explicit issue and portfolio identities
contracts.negative_proof: legacy ready and branch fields grant no claim

contracts.compatibility_period: until upstream non-singleton structural profile is available
contracts.positive_proof: RIPR consumes the upstream non-singleton structural profile
contracts.negative_proof: RIPR does not mint a competing portable graph
